structured_output.summary: The finding is about a weak test. The legend code is already correct, so nothing in src/ changed. I added one new test file, tests/ui/keycap-legend-keys.test.ts. It sets up a desktop matchMedia (fine pointer, 1440×900), resets and syncs the race UI on lap 1, finds the "Keyboard controls" group, and groups its keycaps by label. For STEER, GAS and BRAKE it compares each keycap's SVG polygon `points` with those of a fresh icon('key-left'/'key-right'), icon('key-up') and icon('key-down'), in that order. It also checks that only the GAS keycap has `ui-keycap--primary`, the class that gives it the rally-red background in components.css; the steer, brake and ESC keycaps don't. Red/green: I applied each of the reviewer's three mutations to src/ui/keycap-legend.ts in turn: steer arrows swapped, the up arrow on BRAKE, and the primary flag removed from GAS. The new test failed every time. After restoring the file (checked byte-for-byte with cmp) it passes. pnpm typecheck is clean and pnpm test passes: 84 files, 614 tests.
